condition.question: Is the source DVD visibly transformed to white in EDITED?
condition.criteria: Assess whether the same DVD shown in SOURCE has visibly changed from black to white in EDITED. Establish correspondence using its position, outline, and nearby scene context; a white object or DVD-like disc elsewhere is not evidence that the source DVD changed.
condition.binding: Track the small rectangular, artwork-bearing DVD near the center of SOURCE into EDITED using its location, outline, and surrounding scene context. Do not count either of the two white discs as the transformed DVD solely because it is white or disc-shaped.
condition.source_quote: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
condition.endpoint: The DVD is visibly white rather than black.
condition.necessity: Changing the DVD’s color to white is the explicit requested transformation.
condition.zero_when: The source DVD remains black, is absent without evidence of its transformation, or no requested color change to that same object is visible; unrelated white objects do not count.
condition.half_when: There is concrete but incomplete evidence that the same source DVD is changing toward white, while substantial black coloration remains or correspondence to the source object is genuinely ambiguous.
condition.full_when: The same DVD shown in SOURCE is clearly identifiable by its position, outline, and surrounding scene context in EDITED and is visibly white rather than black, allowing natural lighting, texture, and photographic variation. Whiteness of another object alone is not full achievement.
